title: Commission approves €400 million German State aid to enhance insulin supply resilience
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 Sep 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €400 million German measure in favour of Sanofi-Aventis Deutschland GmbH ('Sanofi') to strengthen the resilience of the supply of human insulin and insulin analogues ('insulins'). Under the measure, Germany will pay Sanofi a public service compensation to provide a service of general economic interest ('SGEI').
